Most bullets end with a period before the link, e.g. `Pulls go-billy to v6.0.0-alpha.2. ([#105](...), [#106](...))`, `Capped at 4 GiB. ([#107](...))`, `...open a PR. ([#106](...))` — the criterion requires no period before the link.

All 14 Security bullets (go-git, toolchain, credentials, ref names, packfile, SSH, URL creds, object limit, advertisement, spill, sanitize, TLS, provenance, permissions) remain, each with its PR link.
go-git appears only in the Security bullet; the Housekeeping #105 entry now covers only test isolation from git config.

judge.reason: The replay renamed the heading, back-filled PR links, added #104/#105, compressed Security bullets and consolidated the go-git mention, satisfying most criteria. However c2 explicitly requires no period before the PR link, and nearly every Security and Added bullet in the replay places the link after a terminating period, so the format requirement is unmet.
